profile.headline: Software Engineer III, Full Stack at Fanatics
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer/Machine Learning engineer developing backend APIs in languages such as Java, Python, and TypeScript. Took ownerships of APIs from start to finish implementing web frameworks such as Flask and Loopback and developed code with Lambda functions. Professional experience committing, branching, and approving code on GitLab for production-level APIs for a healthcare company. Developed machine learning models associated with Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision. Worked on Kaggle datasets such as MNIST, dogs vs. cats, and IMDB movie reviews to gain experience with building and analyzing machine learning models.

positions.title: Software Engineer III, Full Stack
positions.description:
Built internal tool in order to enable operations teams to manage accounts and search audit logs without engineering support. 
Enhanced Lambda authorizer to leverage access tokens instead of ID tokens for more secure and scalable service authentication 
Partnered with stakeholders in order to replace spreadsheet-driven VIP workflows with scalable system logic.  
Optimized the VIP upgrade/downgrade flow by developing and refining UI interactions and improving database query performance  
Debugged SQL queries with long run times to reduce the load of our systems so that users may have a fast experience reading account info  
Implemented Redis Cache in to our CMS backend system due to the high volume of traffic our endpoints get hit along with the data size  
Created a team scripts repo to allow teams to retire accounts, develop test data, award fancash, and many more to automate user experiences  
Integrated DynamoDB and Elasticache in to brand new Springboot Application in order to retrieve audit logs and caching for optimization 
Owned Audit Logging end-to-end in order to provide compliance visibility through DynamoDB-backed search and filtering.  
Developed an account deactivation script in order to automate workflows and productized it into a daily mass-deactivation UI feature.  
Scoped and led Slack app development in order to streamline Confluence-based knowledge retrieval and allow quick resolutions to questions  
Created reusable Terraform Datadog templates in order to standardize observability across services for both MFEs and BFFs 
Mentored a junior engineer in order to accelerate onboarding and knowledge transfer to allow him to be successful from day 1.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 1
positions.description:
Worked as a Backend Software Development Engineer 1
Used Java and Typsecript as primary tech stack to perform API/Lambda function updates and improvements
Updated Lambda functions to implement business requirements such as providing expired data in return payload
Familiarized myself if AWS resources such as Lamba, API Gateway, S3, Secrets Manager, Opensearch
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript

positions.title: Backend API Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Ana, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Took ownership of multiple APIs in programming languages such as TypeScript and Python
Implemented Machine Learning models in to Python APIs using resources such as AWS S3
Used Web frameworks such as Flask and Loopback to create microservices
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Analyst, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work as a consultant to solve many issues clients have with their software and help debug them
Prioritized popular programming languages such as C#, Java, and Python for client needs
Utilized Python to debug the client code to determine where in the code is causing the clients main functionality to go bad
Implemented a logger throughout the client code so that we can do unit tests to examine all inputs and outputs that are occurring and compare it to successful unit tests
Improve the clients video upload time from a 2 hour delay to a 1 minute delay by manually fixing the start time of the video
Created auto-scheduler for client software, using NodeJS, to remove the need for manual input by the user
Led my own team of developers, working as the Project Manager to develop an AI for a client for them to use at the office

positions.title: Basketball Coach
positions.description:
Demonstrated skills to help the players. 
Developed players foundation through repetition and drills.
Taught important life skills that will help them through school and life
Flourished leadership skills as the season went on

volunteerExperiences.description: Dedicated over 200+ hours planning, developing, and ensuring my project came out to be a success. Through endless hard work my goal was to develop an easier and safer way for children to be able to place their belongings at the classroom so that they may go to daycare with ease. The previous system was throwing their belongings in a corner and go play. With my team I created wall mounts outside of the classroom for children to hang their belongings and go play. This project really helped me become a leader because I had to do fundraising, making calls, getting permits approved. This was a tedious process but at the end, it was completely worth it.

projects.title: Bank Classification Model
projects.description: The project's purpose was to determine whether the bank should contact an individual for a special bank offer based on the datasets of those who responded yes or no to the offer. The project uses Logistic Regression and BernoulliNB

projects.title: COVID Dataset EDA
projects.description: Project to perform EDA on the recent COVID outbreak. This project looks at the COVID trends, understanding the spike in cases, and being able to make assumptions as to why there were spikes in that month
